title: Additional information
description: Providing side information is optional. Use the field to include relevant notes about your submission.

title: Contact inquiries
description: The submission form is not a contact form. Direct questions and concerns to the contact page.

title: Appropriate submissions
description: Spam and inappropriate messages are not permitted.

title: Complete information
description: Submissions must contain the requested information relevant to the story.

title: Multi-part stories
description: When submitting stories in parts, include the part number in the title.
